LanguageData.RK_Gene_SmallBody.label: small body
LanguageData.RK_Gene_SmallBody.description: Carriers of this gene have a small frame. Their carrying capacity is slightly reduced.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_Nimble.label: nimble
LanguageData.RK_Gene_Nimble.description: Carriers of this gene have sharper sensory receptors, allowing them to respond more quickly to nearby threats.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_PoorEyesight.label: poor eyesight
LanguageData.RK_Gene_PoorEyesight.description: Carriers of this gene have poor eyesight. They aim more slowly and less accurately.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_FragilePain.label: pain sensitivity
LanguageData.RK_Gene_FragilePain.description: Carriers of this gene have a low pain shock threshold, so even minor wounds can bring them down.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_GoodGardening.label: gardening talent
LanguageData.RK_Gene_GoodGardening.description: Carriers of this gene are more skilled at tending plants.
LanguageData.RK_Skin_PureWhite.label: pure white skin
LanguageData.RK_Skin_PureWhite.description: Carriers of this gene have pure white skin.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_LargeEars.label: large round ears
LanguageData.RK_Gene_LargeEars.description: Carriers of this gene grow large, round ears.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_ThinTail.label: slender tail
LanguageData.RK_Gene_ThinTail.description: Carriers of this gene grow smooth, slender tails.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_CuteFace.label: cute face
LanguageData.RK_Gene_CuteFace.description: Carriers of this gene give off a cute impression. It helps them form social relationships, but can make them seem less serious when representing a group.
